DPP-4 Inhibitors - AZM 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-700351  
Guideline Name 
DPP-4 Inhibitors - AZM  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
9/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:PREFERRED: generic alogliptin, generic alogliptin-metformin, generic 
alogliptin-pioglitazone, Brand Janumet, Janumet XR, Brand Januvia, Jentadueto, Tradjenta  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - The patient has a diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus  
 
AND 


=== PDF PAGE 463 ===
Page 463 
 
2 - ONE of the following:  
 
 2.1 History of failure to metformin at a minimum dose of 1500 milligrams daily for 90 days  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 Contraindication or intolerance to metformin  
 
AND 
 
3 - Provider attests that the requested medication will not be used concurrently with a GLP-1 
RA or combination agent [e.g., Victoza (liraglutide), Byetta (exenatide), Xultophy (insulin 
degludec-liraglutide)], or a plan has been developed to address concomitant use  
Notes  
PA Team Note: To approve products designated "Only Brand Covere
d" or "Brand Over Generic - Not Covered"; flip Brand/Generic Flag to "
Y", approve at MSC "O". 
 
Product Name:NON-PREFERRED: Brynovin, Jentadueto XR, Kombiglyze XR, generic 
saxagliptin-metformin ER, Brand Onglyza, generic saxagliptin, Brand Zituvimet, Brand 
Sitagliptin-metformin, Zituvimet XR, Brand Sitagliptin-metformin XR, Brand Zituvio, Brand 
Sitagliptin, generic sitagliptin phosphate, generic sitagliptin phosphate-metformin, generic 
sitagliptin phosphate-metformin ER  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - The patient has a diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus  
 
AND 
 
2 - ONE of the following:  
 
 2.1 History of failure to metformin at a minimum dose of 1500 milligrams daily for 90 days  


=== PDF PAGE 464 ===
Page 464 
 
OR 
 
 2.2 Contraindication or intolerance to metformin  
 
AND 
 
3 - ONE of the following:  
 
 3.1 History of failure for 90 days to three of the following:  
• 
generic alogliptin, generic alogliptin-metformin, or generic alogliptin-pioglitazone  
• 
Brand Januvia  
• 
Brand Janumet/Janumet XR  
• 
Jentadueto  
• 
Tradjenta  
 
OR 
 
 3.2 Intolerance or contraindication to THREE of the following:  
• 
generic alogliptin, generic alogliptin-metformin, or generic alogliptin-pioglitazone  
• 
Brand Januvia  
• 
Brand Janumet/Janumet XR  
• 
Jentadueto  
• 
Tradjenta  
 
AND 
 
4 - Provider attests that the requested medication will not be used concurrently with a GLP-1 
RA or combination agent [e.g., Victoza (liraglutide), Byetta (exenatide), Xultophy (insulin 
degludec-liraglutide)], or a plan has been developed to address concomitant use  
 
2 .  Revision History  
 
Date  
Notes  
8/26/2026  
Added new generic for Janumet XR as NPD.
